purpose: Teach: 練馬/ニンテンドー/ローリング/ヤフオク/ホモ/シャロン/スタミナ/チャンピオンズ

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが練馬区で勤務された
lines.en: Gran, when your father was young, he used to work out in Nerima Ward.
lines.style: Soft, reaching back into memory. Open the line gently. Warm nostalgia in the pacing. Let the thought hang a moment before trailing off, as if checking whether the memory is right.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん、お祖父ちゃん、ニンテンドーのファミコンを孫に買って下さったわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Yes, dear — and your grandfather bought our grandchildren a Nintendo Famicom, didn't he?
lines.style: Bright, present-moment joy breaking through the past. Lean into the word 'bought' with gentle affection. Slight lift at the end, inviting agreement like a cherished shared joke.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんがローリング・ストーンズのレコードを買われた
lines.en: Gran, when your father was young, he bought a Rolling Stones record.
lines.style: Same soft reach into memory. Quieter than before — a smaller recollection, held carefully. Almost asking permission to remember it out loud.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、晩年はヤフオクで懐かしいものを集められたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Your grandfather used to collect old things on Yahoo Auctions in his later years, didn't he, dear?
lines.style: Warm recognition of his quirks. Affectionate teasing underneath. The tone of someone who watched him do this, amused and patient. Soft rise on 'didn't he.'

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんがホモ・エレクトスの本を読まれた
lines.en: Gran, when your father was young, he read books about Homo erectus.
lines.style: Quieter still. Tender precision — this is a specific, unlikely memory, offered almost apologetically. Slow. Let the unusual detail sit without explanation.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、シャロン元首相の死去を悼まれたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Your grandfather mourned the death of former Prime Minister Sharon, didn't he, dear?
lines.style: Matter-of-fact warmth. No performance — just stating a fact she remembers clearly about him. Steady rhythm. Slight softening on his name, like naming someone you miss.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんがスタミナ十分でいらした
lines.en: Gran, when your father was young, he had plenty of stamina.
lines.style: Softest of all. Almost a sigh. The line carries a weight underneath — youth, strength, time passing. Open and unguarded. Let it fade naturally.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、チャンピオンズリーグの決勝をご覧になったわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Your grandfather watched the Champions League final, didn't he, dear?
lines.style: Closing warmth. Gentle certainty. The final touch of tenderness — a small, happy detail to end on. Slight smile in the voice. Soft, satisfied finish.
